FOREWORD This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the draft finalized by the Automotive Electrical Equipment Sectional Committee had been approved by the Transport Engineering Division Council. This standard'specifies the colour code for the wiring used in Automotive facilitate easy distinction while wiring the different circuits. Vehicles in order to

In preparing this standard, assistance has been derived from DIN 72551 ( Part 4 ) : 1951 `Electric cabIes for automobiles and motorcycles - Colour identification' issued by the certain deviations and additional Deutsches Institut fur Normung, Germany. However, connections have been'specified so as to avoid any confusion while wiring and also for quicker identification of the circuits.

AUTOMOTIVE VEHICLES-ELECTRICAL WIRING-COLOUR CODING
1 SCOPE 1.1 This standard specifies colour codes for automobile cables conforming to IS 2465 : 1984 Cables for motor vehicles ( second revision )' circuits in used for major electrical starting, charging, such as automotives signaIling, lighting, tell-tale warning and safety devices. 1.2 This standard does not cover such electrical circuits, as for airconditioning, electronic automatic carburration, anti-skid braking, transmission etc. 2 REFERENCE 2.1 The following Indian Standard necessary. adjunct to this standard. The Standard Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard under a well defined system of inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by BIS and operated by the producer. Standard marked products are also continuously checked by BIS for conformity to that standard as a further safeguard. Details of conditions under which a licence for the use of the Standard Mark may be granted to manufacturers or producers may be obtained from the Bureau of Indian Standards.
